title: How many Earths fit between Earth and the Moon?
subtitle: Guess how many Earths would fill the gap to the Moon, then watch all the other planets squeeze into the same gap, drawn to scale.
notes: Number-line guess (unit 'Earths' on the line now), then 30 Earth discs in the gap, then all seven planets to scale (giants with true flattening); Moon nudged out to apogee. size_compare considered: it takes at most 4 items, and the payoff is seven planets, so the hand figure stays. affirm playful.
